dedupe_keys.name: climateserv historical and forecast data portal

description: SERVIR collaborators publish ClimateSERV, a web platform for viewing and obtaining rainfall, vegetation and seasonal forecast products relevant to water availability. Its repository describes a Django service for historical rainfall, vegetation condition and 180-day rainfall and temperature outlooks. Users select an area, variable and date period; the service returns maps or data for that query. Geographic coverage follows the upstream products exposed by the deployed portal. The repository README displays MIT terms for the software and documents deployment, though some configuration steps remain marked to be completed. A limitation is that a portal can expose products with different licences, resolution and forecast skill; the code licence does not grant reuse of every underlying dataset. ClimateSERV can prepare climate drivers for drought, irrigation and reservoir simulations. The related catalogue ERA5 record is one weather reanalysis, not this multi-product service. No service data or server package was downloaded.
